proof_body:
by
  intro R S _ _ _ _ hinj P hP
  have hk : Ideal.comap (algebraMap R S) (⊥ : Ideal S) ≤ P := by
    rw [← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, (RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot _).mp hinj]
    exact bot_le
  obtain ⟨Q, -, hQ, h⟩ := Ideal.exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral P (⊥ : Ideal S) hk
  exact ⟨Q, hQ, h⟩
target_source: ∀ (R S : Type*) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [Algebra.IsIntegral R S], Function.Injective (algebraMap R S) → ∀ P : Ideal R, P.IsPrime → ∃ Q : Ideal S, Q.IsPrime ∧ Ideal.comap (algebraMap R S) Q = P
